glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辶 (= 辵) (“walk”) + phonetic 言. The character was originally a verb meaning “to meet”, whose modern pronunciation is yàn. It was later borrowed for the proximal demonstrative “this/here”, by a confusion in medieval handwriting with 遮 (“this”).
senses: [yàn] (obsolete) to welcome; to greet; to receive
(Xiamen, &, Taiwanese Hokkien) alternative form of 遮
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 這; s_page_origin explains the simplified 这.
